## Relevant Symbols

- `hooks/session-launch.sh:282-284` — the workers' cache (#126): `WORKER_ENV` sets `XDG_CACHE_HOME`, `GOCACHE` and `npm_config_cache` into `WCACHE`, which is in the worker's `allowWrite`. The lane cache follows the same variable set, plus `PIP_CACHE_DIR`, `YARN_CACHE_FOLDER` and `BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR`.
- `hooks/lane-guard.sh:180` — `is_hefesto_helper` names the four helpers that run outside the sandbox. `lane-build.sh` must not join it.
- `hooks/quality-before-commit.sh:257`, `run-tests-after-edit.sh:12`, `format-after-edit.sh:12`, `verify-before-task-complete.sh:33` — the project-command hooks stand down in a lanes project and in a worker (#169). So no hefesto hook builds in a lane.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions

- Setup records what it added (`HEFESTO_SETUP_EXTRA`, `:178`) and `--remove` strips exactly that (`:273-283`).
- A helper refuses with the cause and the fix, and never exits 0 on a refusal (constitution 5).
- A guard's test pairs the refusal with a mutant (constitution 3); a canary file proves a program did or did not run (the #169 block in `tests/smoke.sh`).

## Facts From the Claude Code Docs (2026-11-04)

- A hook process inherits the parent environment; a settings `env` reaches every subprocess (sandboxing.md, hooks.md "Common input fields").
- `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` merges across settings scopes and applies to every sandboxed command (sandboxing.md "Configure sandboxing").
- No variable can be set for sandboxed commands only.
- Whether `excludedCommands` and the sandbox decision use a PreToolUse `updatedInput` is undocumented; so is `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`'s interplay with the sandbox.
